lines.say: Welcome to Class 31. Giving Instructions and Explaining Procedures.
Rule one. Use the imperative and sequence words for steps.

show.text: Use the imperative and sequence words for steps.
show.bn: কোনো কাজের ধাপ বোঝাতে আদেশসূচক বাক্য এবং ধারাবাহিকতা নির্দেশক শব্দ ব্যবহার করুন।

lines.say: First, please sit down.
Notice first.
Then, relax your arm.
Notice then.
Rule two. Use the passive to describe a procedure: is checked, is measured, is recorded.

show.text: Use the passive to describe a procedure: is checked, is measured, is recorded.
